Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry (CLMS) study using the photo-reactive cross-linker sulfo-SDA to map interactions within the CRL4DCAF1/Vprmus/SAMHD1 complex. While the study discusses ubiquitylation, the MS analysis itself is focused on the cross-linked complex (complexome) rather than a PTM-enrichment workflow like diGly. Base workflow is DDA; modifier is complexome.

scope: crosslinking mass spectrometry results for sulfo-SDA crosslinking of human CUL4-NEDD8/ROC1/DDB1/DCAF1-CtD in complex with SAMHD1 and Vpr protein from simian immunodeficiency virus infecting Cercopithecus cephus (SIVmus Vpr)
Purified CUL4/ROC1, DDB1/DCAF1-CtD, GST-Vprmus and rhesus macaque SAMHD1, 1 μM each, were incubated in a volume of 3 mL buffer

The gel band corresponding to the cross-linked complex was excised and digested with trypsin (Thermo Scientific Pierce) and the resulting tryptic peptides were extracted and desalted using C18 StageTips.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by mass spectrometry was a reconstituted complex of purified recombinant proteins (CUL4, ROC1, DDB1, DCAF1, SAMHD1, and Vpr), which were individually purified via affinity tags (GST, His) and then assembled in vitro.
